prompt.task: Design the first three experiments for a new target before any target outcome is known. Optimize early best-so-far AUC first and final-best outcome second across the fixed sequential budget.

execution_protocol.later_rounds: The LLM will choose one experiment per round from a menu containing GP-UCB, source-prior, and geometric candidates.

decision_rules: Select exactly three unique IDs from candidate_shortlist.
Keep hypothesis and mechanism under 55 words each.
Use exactly three candidate assessments and keep each reason under 25 words.
Use at most three failure conditions and keep each under 25 words.
Select at least one candidate ranked in the top five by source evidence.
Use one plausible quality anchor, one mechanism discriminator, and one geometry probe.
The three candidates must include at least two public categorical condition signatures when possible.
At least one pair must differ materially in normalized numeric conditions.
Do not cluster all three candidates in the same local operating region.
Candidate assessments must cover all three selected candidates.
Source scores are priors, not target measurements. Never invent target outcomes.
prompt.evidence_boundary: No target outcomes are present in this prompt.

  "mechanism": "Temperature is the dominant driver (correlation 0.68) across both sources. Strong amidine bases (BTMG/TMG) deprotonate the amide efficiently, accelerating oxidative addition/reductive elimination independent of precatalyst identity, so the thermal-base pattern should transfer to AlPhos.",

    {"candidate_id": "baumgartner_cn_benzamide_alphos_021", "role": "mechanism_probe", "expected_outcome": 80.0, "confidence": 0.55, "reason": "TMG at 100C tests whether high temperature plus alternate amidine base drives yield."},
    {"candidate_id": "baumgartner_cn_benzamide_alphos_023", "role": "geometry_probe", "expected_outcome": 45.0, "confidence": 0.4, "reason": "MTBD at low 30C, long residence; probes cold weak-base corner far from anchor."}

}
